title: Another gem in Seville
text:
Only around a five minute stroll from the Setas yet walking from from the street into Palacio de las Duenas feels like being transported into a different world.

We visited on a Friday morning in early October arriving around 11:00.  We had not booked tickets in advance and found no queue for tickets at 15 euro each, and relatively few visitors once inside.  The price point is I think very reasonable. Guided tours are offered at a higher price though we found a self-guided tour quite simple

author: TheShirtSpeaks

title: Fascinating
text: Unique and fascinating place, beautiful grounds and extensive art collection amassed over 400+ years.  For a history buff (I plead guilty!), a must-see.  Thoroughly enjoyed the venue and the accompanying descriptions.  Surprisingly, not at all crowded.
author: ectrim

title: Wonderful
text: We purchased tickets at the door and not the  audio guide, preferring to just go around at our own pace and direction. There was not a queue. The palace is wonderful, plenty to look at and the garden areas are very relaxing. We enjoyed it more than Real Alcazar, probably because It was less busy - still very spectacular. I would highly recommend visiting whilst in Seville.
author: barney513

title: Stunning place with a wealth of history
text: An absolute must! A little-known palace hidden away near Las Setas. The palace was built between 15th and 16th century, is set in stunning grounds and well-maintained gardens and courtyards, with a wealth of history. To fully explore and appreciate the many rooms of the palace and grounds, allow around 1 1/2-2 hours. It is well worth a visit and worth the €15 per head, but recommend a Monday visit when it is free of charge.
author: Tour151684

title: A living jewel of Seville that exists through time.
text: The Palacio de las Dueñas is one of the few visitable examples of still-lived Sevillian noble architecture. It is not a reconstruction or a staged setting; it is a real place, with centuries of history accumulated in every stone. An essential visit not only to understand Seville but also to understand Spain.
author: JuaniRodriguezlop

title: Worth the visit!
text:
A must-visit while in Seville! Tucked away in the heart of the city, Palacio de Dueñas is a beautiful and peaceful escape from the busy streets.

The gardens are stunning, filled with flowers and orange trees, and the palace offers a fascinating insight into the history of the Alba family. What I loved most was how relaxed it felt – despite being so central, it never seemed overcrowded, making it easy to take your time and enjoy the surroundings.

A beautiful spot that’s definitely worth adding to your Seville itinerary.

title: Beautiful palace
text:
The Palace of Las Dueñas is a magnificent home.
A visit to discover Seville.
The building with its mudéjar-renaissance architecture with its patio, its gardens with many plants.
Favourite residence of Duchess Cayetana de Alba where there are personal archives including her collection of Art.
Audioguide available for free but be careful to download on your smartphone.
author: ingb2014

title: Relaxing place
text:
Such a lovely place to visit, with an interesting history and beautiful gardens to relax in. 

A special mention to manager Maria who helped us when a technical glitch occurred. Great customer service, it was appreciated.
author: Vicand26
